info.title: InverseArena API
info.description: REST API for wallet auth, arenas, pools, leaderboard, payouts, and admin round resolution.

bearerAuth.description: Wallet JWT access token from POST /api/auth/verify

adminApiKey.name: X-Admin-Api-Key
adminApiKey.description: Admin API key for privileged routes

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Scoped API key for third-party read access (#1737)

nonce.example: Sign this message to authenticate: abc123

post.summary: Verify wallet signature and issue tokens

get.summary: Per-round yield time-series for an arena

200.description: Ordered yield snapshots (round, timestamp, rate, accrued, cumulative); amounts are decimal strings in the arena stake asset

404.description: Transaction not found or not owned by requester

get.description: One item per arena, aggregating payout records, cancellation recovery and on-chain arena state. Ownership comes from the bearer token; there is no wallet parameter. A failed on-chain read yields state `unavailable`, never an empty result and never a zeroed amount.

get.summary: List the authenticated creator's arena configuration templates
get.description: Every template carries its field-level remediation: what is stale against the current protocol bounds, registry lifecycle and deployment capabilities.

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

post.description: The payload is canonical: the stake amount is in the asset's minor units and the asset and integrations are contract ids. It is validated against the current protocol rules before it is stored; a payload that does not satisfy them is refused with field-level remediation.

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

409.description: A template with this name already exists

422.description: The template does not satisfy the current protocol rules

get.summary: Read one of the creator's templates

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

patch.summary: Update one of the creator's templates
patch.description: `expectedRevision` must match the stored revision, so a concurrent edit is refused instead of overwritten.

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

409.description: Revision conflict, or the name is taken

delete.summary: Delete one of the creator's templates

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

post.summary: Clone one of the creator's templates

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

409.description: A template with this name already exists

post.summary: Archive or restore one of the creator's templates

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

post.summary: Prepare a template for the creation form
post.description: Returns the payload to prefill the creation form, revalidated against the current rules. Applying it never bypasses the transaction preview or the balance and trustline checks.

404.description: Template not found (also returned for another wallet's template)

422.description: The template's schema version is not supported

get.description: Aggregates health signals from all subsystems (API, database, Redis, stream, keeper, RPC, oracle, maintenance) into a single public-facing response suitable for rendering a status page. Edge-cacheable.

201.description: API key created (raw key shown only once)

409.description: Only active keys can be rotated

get.description: Returns a JSON archive of all off-chain personal data linked to the authenticated user: identity, aliases, watched arenas, notification preferences, push subscriptions, transactions, audit logs.
Returns the retention matrix explaining which data categories are erasable, which are retained (pseudonymized) for compliance, and which cannot be erased (on-chain data).

post.description: Executes the erasure workflow: deletes erasable data, pseudonymizes retained rows, revokes sessions and push subscriptions. Returns 409 if blockers exist (pending payouts).

409.description: Erasure blocked (pending payouts) or already in progress
